mapper.select: WITH totals AS ( SELECT day, SUM(upload) AS upload, SUM(download) AS download, SUM(upload_ack) AS upload_ack, SUM(download_ack) AS download_ack, SUM(seeding) AS seeding, SUM(downloading) AS downloading, SUM(loss) AS loss FROM user_traffic_daily WHERE day BETWEEN #{from} AND #{through} GROUP BY day ) SELECT days.day::date::text AS day, COALESCE(upload, 0)::text AS upload, COALESCE(download, 0)::text AS download, COALESCE(upload_ack, 0)::text AS "uploadAck", COALESCE(download_ack, 0)::text AS "downloadAck", COALESCE(seeding, 0)::text AS seeding, COALESCE(downloading, 0)::text AS downloading, COALESCE(loss, 0)::text AS loss FROM generate_series((SELECT MIN(day) FROM totals)::timestamp, CAST(#{through} AS timestamp), INTERVAL '1 day') AS days(day) LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.day = days.day::date ORDER BY days.day
